changes.comment: Add cron scheduling for every conversational agent: each TeamLeader now owns a durable cron scheduler and cron MCP surface alongside the dispatcher scheduler. TeamLeader cron jobs are stored at `~/.dreamux/state/<dispatcher-id>/team/<team-id>/cron-jobs.json` while retaining the existing job schema and dispatcher_id validation; Team isolation is by path. Non-closed Team schedulers are eager-armed at dispatcher boot without starting TeamLeader runtimes, and a scheduled fire lazy-starts the TeamLeader through its own `scheduledInput` path. Closed/dissolved Teams are not armed, and `team.dissolve` deletes that Team's cron jobs. Regular Team members still receive no cron MCP. No Rebuild required; delete a Team's `cron-jobs.json` manually only if you intentionally want to clear that TeamLeader's scheduled tasks without dissolving the Team.
